## Built-in prompts {#app-prompt .unnumbered}

:::{.callout-note}

# Prompt: Extracting the schema from the text

```{r echo = FALSE}
tines::prompt_extract_schema(text = "[inset text here]", data_dict = NA)  
```

:::

:::{.callout-note}

# Prompt: generating code from the schema

```{r echo = FALSE}
tines::prompt_gen_code()
```
:::


:::{.callout-note}

# Prompt: validating the code generated 

```{r echo = FALSE}
cat(strwrap(tines:::build_sys_prompt(data = "[insert the path to the data]"), width = 70), sep = "\n")
```
:::

:::{.callout-note}

# Prompt: generating alternatives for a specific step

```{r echo = FALSE}
tines::prompt_alternatives(step = "[inset step number here]")
```

:::
